notes: «- يعني ابن أبي الزرقاء -» is an editor's gloss on Haroun: left out
«أبي» and «أبيه» are bare relations (rule 7): the text names neither
The Companion Wa'il b. Hujr ends the chain; the saying is the story of the collector's sending

fixes.reason: HKG names the bare «أبي» as Zayd b. Yazid b. Abi al-Zarqa', a name the text does not write.

evidence.quote: زيد بن يزيد بن أبي الزرقاء
